bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears have officially ruled out quarterback Caleb Williams for Sunday's game against the Jets due to a hamstring injury, marking his second straight missed game, with either Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum expected to start in his place. Either Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum will start at quarterback for the Bears Sunday against the Jets, in place of Caleb Williams, who will miss his second straight game with a hamstring injury.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are preparing for their Week 4 Sunday Night Football matchup against the Carolina Panthers, with the team releasing a practice squad cornerback and elevating a rookie tight end, while the coach confirmed a starting guard could lose his job when the center returns from injury . Meanwhile, safety Brian Branch is nearing a return to the practice field after missing the start of the 2026 season while recovering from a torn Achilles , a potential boost for Detroit's defense ahead of the game.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers released their Week 4 injury report Thursday ahead of Sunday's game at Tampa Bay, ruling out OL Aaron Banks and Jacob Monk while listing LB Edgerrin Cooper as questionable . The offensive line remains a major storyline after Green Bay's recent additions, with the Packers possessing the worst pass-blocking offensive line in football entering the week, a situation no other team is close to , putting added pressure on newcomers like Kevin Zeitler to stabilize the unit.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Justin Jefferson has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 4 matchup against the Miami Dolphins due to a sprained right ankle sustained against Tampa Bay, with coach Kevin O'Connell noting on Friday that "He's definitely feeling better," and "He's going to get treatment throughout the next couple days." Despite the loss of their star receiver, the unbeaten 3-0 Vikings are focused on taking care of business against the winless 0-3 Dolphins as they return home to Minneapolis for the first time since Week 1.
